title: A public event page serves its cover right-sized and asks for it first

source.ref: SEO, GEO and speed deep scan 2026-11-19 (production crawl of 3,000 URLs, all 720 sitemap pages, 8 crawler user agents, Lighthouse on 14 templates)

detail: An event page weighed 2.2 MB, 1.24 MB of it one PNG cover used as a CSS background, found late by the browser (Lighthouse simulated phone LCP 12.8 s). The cover from our own storage is now requested through the built-in image optimizer at 1080 wide and preloaded with high priority. Checked on production with the same address the page will use: 1,266 KB PNG became a 41 KB AVIF, status 200. A cover from any other host is used as it is. The storage host is already in the optimizer's allowed list, so this adds no new service.

verify.note: Fails on main: the raw cover is the background and nothing preloads it. Passes once the rendition and the preload are in place.
